p1c1.caption: Turin · 30 September 1888 — a declaration of war
p1c1.opener: #chapter-art.motif emblem (300px sounding-fork: tuning fork striking a plinth fragment before the giant black ? silhouette with cast shadow; 1 broken sound-ring + nodal bar + bronze sunspot slash) + Cinzel .72rem ash colophon caption; then .chapter-meta: part eyebrow with 64×4px black shadow-bar beneath (meta-part::after), Cinzel title 'Foreword', #meta-number hidden (label duplicates title), book bronze rule kept.
p1c1.palette_role: Bronze on forge; ember absent — no blood drawn yet, first tap only. 1 ring (T1).
p1c1.part_subtitle: How to Philosophize with a Hammer
p1c1.rationale: Declaration of war whose weapon is a TUNING FORK ('touched here with a hammer as if with a tuning fork'); the revaluation is 'a question mark so black, so immense, that it casts a shadow'; cheerfulness/sunshine against gloom; signed Turin, 30 Sept 1888. The instrument is introduced before any idol exists.
p1c1.reading_treatment: Two paragraphs, calm Cormorant body, book bronze Cinzel drop-cap kept. Signature line ('Friedrich Nietzsche', p:last-of-type) right-aligned Cormorant italic 1.1rem ash with 3rem top margin — a letter closing. End seal: book ring (A.0), untouched.
p1c1.title: Foreword

p1c2.caption: Thirty stanzas · staccato — one at a time
p1c2.opener: #chapter-art.motif emblem (340px fanned-barbs: 30-dart volley fan from a lower-left strike point, bone shafts / bronze fletching / ember rhomboid heads, the 30th dart held horizontal on a hairline tightrope wire; 2 broken rings) + DM Sans .72rem ash count-strip caption. SMALL-end Cinzel 600 title (percent rule: clamp(1.5rem,3.4vw,2rem), .14em tracking) with 4rem meta air — monumentality through spacing, not size. Number kept; book rule kept.
p1c2.palette_role: Bone + bronze with ember tips (book-identity palette_role); hairline cracks only — barbs scratch, they don't shatter. 2 rings (T1).
p1c2.part_subtitle: How to Philosophize with a Hammer
p1c2.rationale: Thrown aphoristic barbs ('we must shoot at morality'); tightrope walker (fall/stand/get away); Military School of Life; 'whatever does not kill me makes me stronger'; closing formula 'a yes, a no, a straight line, a goal'. COUNT HONESTY: 30 served paragraphs (44 aphorisms in print — several served paras chain 2–3 maxims with em-dashes, e.g. idx 5, 24–27); maxims cannot be split without prose edits (forbidden), so numerals mark the 30 reading stanzas the reader pages through.
p1c2.reading_treatment: Staccato stanzas: each paragraph max-width 44ch, centered, margin-bottom 1.9em, 1.12rem/1.7. Bare stanza numerals via CSS counters (content-true sequence — the allowed exception; no chip/box/circle/border): Cinzel .68rem ash in the left margin (-3.4rem desktop, -2.6rem tablet, inline-block above on phone). Final stanza (idx 29, the Formula) 1.2× size, centered, bronze first line. End seal: book ring.
p1c2.title: Maxims And Barbs

p1c3.caption: Reason = Virtue = Happiness — the indicted equation
p1c3.opener: #chapter-art.motif emblem (widest of the cohort, min(420px,80vw): hemisected Socratic mask — dense ivory hatch daylight half vs near-black ember-cracked half, 2.5px jogged median crack, crossed fencing foils, 3 bronze syllogism blades, plinth inscription with ember-cracked second '=', kylix cup with ember interior, 36px Asclepius rooster; 3 rings clipped to the daylight side) + Cinzel .95rem bronze equation caption — the formula shown before demolition. Full book title scale (long discursive chapter).
p1c3.palette_role: Ember co-dominant vs bone — harshest contrast in the cohort (harsh daylight vs dark desires). 3 rings (T1), all clipped to the daylight side: reason's glare has a direction.
p1c3.part_subtitle: How to Philosophize with a Hammer
p1c3.rationale: Dialectics as rabble revenge ('knife-thrusts of the syllogism'); the indicted equation reason=virtue=happiness; Socrates the buffoon/fencing-master and the new agon; harsh daylight of reason vs dark desires; the self-administered hemlock cup; the cock owed to Asclepius.
p1c3.reading_treatment: 12 long paragraphs, calm body, book drop-cap. Two authorial pivots get air (margin-top 2.6em) each preceded by an authored CSS-arc divider (hammerfall-divider.svg via p::before, 160px, curves never rails): para 7 (idx 6, 'You choose dialectics only when…') and para 12 (idx 11, 'expression of décadence…'). End seal: book ring.
p1c3.title: The Problem Of Socrates

p1c4.caption: Four propositions · read as indictments
p1c4.opener: #chapter-art.motif emblem (340px mummy-case: upright canopic case on a solid forge disc, 5-arc broad collar, 9 ash wrap lines, 4 cartouche plaques UNITY/MATERIALITY/SUBSTANCE/DURATION, 4px ember crown-to-base crack with chest breach, bronze vine bursting through with 5 leaves + tendril, profile nose with exhale arcs, 3 toppled grammar I-bars; 4 rings, two broken by the vine) + DM Sans .72rem ash count-strip caption. Title keeps quotes; full book title scale (long discursive chapter).
p1c4.palette_role: Ember-break: widest cracks (4px), bronze rings straining; bone wrap-lines vs bronze vine (life breaking the mummy). Darkest emblem ground of the four. 4 rings (T1) — most in cohort.
p1c4.part_subtitle: How to Philosophize with a Hammer
p1c4.rationale: Egypticism: philosophers make MUMMIES of concepts; idol-worship is mortal danger ('they become a mortal danger to everything when they worship'); the nose as finest instrument vs reason; language/grammar deceit ('not getting rid of God because we still believe in grammar'); the Four Propositions — second content-true sequence (Third + Fourth share served para idx 8; styled without prose edits).
p1c4.reading_treatment: Paras 0–4 (diagnosis) calm. Proposition paras = 7th/8th/9th p overall (nth-of-type 7/8/9): anvil tablets (anvil fill, 1px bone-18% hairline outline, square, no shadow) + Cinzel .95rem bronze first line landing exactly on the 'FIRST/SECOND/THIRD PROPOSITION.' leads + arc-divider ::before above each panel. Para 9 (Third+Fourth merged) carries an ::after caption 'THIRD + FOURTH — ONE BREATH, TWO BLOWS' (Cinzel .65rem ash). End seal: book ring.
p1c4.title: 'Reason' In Philosophy

cohort_notes: First sounding: the instrument (p1c1) before any idol, then barbs (p1c2), mask (p1c3), mummy-case (p1c4). T1: ring counts are honest content — 1/2/3/4 per chapter, recorded in each entry's rings field; validator counts bronze concentric ring paths (class hf-ring) per emblem. Crack widths widen 0.75→1→2.5→4px ember. Zero DOM insertions: declarative manifest + pure CSS on existing nodes only (contract §3). p1c2 numerals mark 30 served stanzas (44 aphorisms in print — both true, different units).

design.composition: Contract-declarative openers: #chapter-art emblem + figcaption strip FIRST, then .chapter-meta (part → Cinzel title → number → book bronze rule), then calm body. Slot-above-meta order is contract-forced (§2) over the book doc's eyebrow-first sketch. p1c2's poster-class air comes from the percent rule (small title + 4rem meta air), not a giant hero.

direction_comparison.name: D1. War Broadside (rejected)
direction_comparison.note: Marinetti-style diagonal condensed caps, poster bars, tilted blocks. Unreadable across 30 stanzas; fights the calm-body contract; poster bars read as rail rules; ignores the approved identity. Salvaged only as the p1c2 volley fan.

direction_comparison.name: D2. Gray Philology (rejected)
direction_comparison.note: TeX-like equation displays, data tables, monochrome gray + cobalt. Bloodless — exactly the mummifying posture Nietzsche attacks in p1c4. Fails the title-swap test: would suit Kant.

direction_comparison.name: D3. STRUCK BRONZE / Sounding-Out (CHOSEN — book-identity + T-critique conformant)
direction_comparison.note: Ivory line-engraving on forge-black: one strike-point emblem per opener (idol-form + impact crack + N sound-rings, N = chapter index), hammer shown once as the p1c1 tuning fork, calm Cormorant body, manifest caption strips, CSS-arc dividers, stanza/tablet reading treatments, p1c1 shadow-bar. Literalizes the Foreword's stated sounding procedure; title-swap fails for any other book.

design.illustration: Original hand-authored SVG line-engraving in art/hammerfall.svg: bone (#EDE2CC) 2.5px incised strokes, bronze (#D29A4A) strike points + sound-rings, ember (#B23A2A) cracks only, ash (#A89A80) secondary line. Fills only: p1c1 black ? silhouette (+ offset cast shadow), kylix ember interior, p1c4 forge disc. No stock, no gradients-as-subject, no pseudo-glyphs. Symbol ids equal v1.1 symbol keys AND motif ids (sounding-fork, fanned-barbs, hemisected-mask, mummy-case).
references: Ernst Chladni, Entdeckungen über die Theorie des Klanges (1787) — bowed-plate nodal figures; model for the broken sound-ring language. deutschestextarchiv.de/book/view/chladni_klang_1787, e-rara.ch/zut/doi/10.3931/e-rara-4235, archive.org/details/entdeckungenuber00chla

Die Brücke woodcuts (Kirchner, Heckel, Schmidt-Rottluff c.1905–1910) — hemisected faces; adopted inside the book's engraving craft (woodcut itself rejected per book direction B). moma.org/s/ge/curated_ge/styles/brucke.html
F. T. Marinetti, Zang Tumb Tumb (1914) — futurist war-typography, studied-then-rejected for reading calm; energy survives as the p1c2 volley. moma.org/collection/works/31450
Book-identity: design/ART-DIRECTION.md + book-identity.json + design/book.css (STRUCK BRONZE / sounding-out) — conformed exactly.

ArtDirector critique .omp/design/critiques/twilight-of-the-idols.md — PROVISIONAL PASS T1–T6 binding: T1 honest rings 1/2/3/4, percent rule for p1c2, T2 Cormorant reclamation, T6 supervisor REVISE pre-answers (unboxed emblems, balanced title wrap, zero fleuron interaction).
design.signature: The strike-point: one idol-form + one impact crack + N broken sound-rings (N = chapter index, T1), delivered declaratively into #chapter-art.motif. p1c1 shows the instrument (tuning fork, no idol yet); cracks widen hairline→4px across the cohort.

type.body: Cormorant Garamond 400–500, 1.3rem/1.8, ≤65ch, already loaded (T2 deliberate reclamation). Never set aphorism body in Cinzel.
type.chrome: DM Sans, already loaded: count-strip captions, header, TOC. Untouched.
type.display: Cinzel 600–700 via var(--font-display) from book.css; supervisor adds family=Cinzel:wght@600;700 to the fonts link. Part line, titles, equation caption, proposition leads, stanza numerals. Percent rule: p1c2 title at the SMALL end of the clamp + wider tracking + more air.
type.scale: Part .78rem tracked .34em bronze (book) → title clamp(1.9rem,5vw,3rem) Cinzel 700 (book; p1c2 small-end override) → figcaption strips per chapter → body 1.3rem/1.8 → p1c2 stanzas 1.12rem/1.7.

engineer_notes.path_note: Divider arc is a data-URI background in design/hammerfall.css (self-contained: no path or merge-order dependency). The canonical hammerfall-divider symbol also ships in art/hammerfall.svg for slot/inline use. Exactly three owned files per supervisor ruling.
engineer_notes.placement: #chapter-art slot (reader.js-injected above #chapter-meta per contract §3). Manifest uses v1.1 explicit symbol form {src, symbol, class, motif, caption}. Supervisor merges this cohort JSON's chapters into design/chapters.json sequentially; loads design/hammerfall.css AFTER design/book.css; adds Cinzel 600;700 to the fonts link.
